headlines.text: Rewind to 2023, when a new champion was crowned for the AEW TNT Title as Wardlow vs. Powerhouse Hobbs battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.64 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. Wardlow recaptured the TNT Championship from Powerhouse Hobbs with three powerbombs, only to be immediately confronted by a returning Christian Cage and Luchasaurus, setting up his next feud on the spot.
That Wednesday in 2023, Sammy Guevara vs. Jack Perry met in a Tournament Match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 6.92.
That Wednesday in 2023, it marked the first-ever meeting between Jay White and Komander on Dynamite, rated 6.51.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2023, 2.O & Hager made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.45.
